#There is a difference in ARPU calculated by TRAI and the figures published by TSPs in their financial statements. This is
because each TSP has a different methodology to calculate the ARPU. For example, one of the TSPs calculated ARPU by
dividing the service revenue by the average number of subscribers during the quarter. Another TSP calculated ARPU by
dividing operating revenue as given in the P&L account for the quarter by the average subscriber base for the current and
previous quarters. Further, TRAI calculates ARPU per month as Quarterly Revenue adjusted for interconnect usage charges
and roaming settlement charges divided by average subscribers during the quarter for its own regulatory analysis.
Therefore, the different methods result in a TRAI ARPU figure being less than what a TSP would declare in its quarterly
financial results or presents to investors/Credit rating agencies.
